newsitem.title: FRANCE: French shares come down from jobless spike.
newsitem.headline: French shares come down from jobless spike.

text.p: French shares reduced their gains made on the back of lower-than-expected U.S. job creation numbers and were trading lower than when the report was published.
At 1300, the CAC-40 index was up 0.21 percent at 2645.04 after it had been as high as 2,662.26. May futures were up 0.23 percent at 2629.0.
Volume was a modest 2.9 billion francs with many investors sidelined due to extended holidays after May Day on Thursday.
